_readme: Template only. Copy to arena_plotting.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Shared: other configs pull it in with "_include", so it is set once. Used by steps 7 to 9.

arena_plotting._readme: Static arena objects (fruit, leaves, arena frame) drawn into the 3D plots and the reprojection images of main_points3d.py / main_tracks3d.py / main_tracks3d_guided.py (--no-arena to skip). fruit: the red fake fruit, found without annotations. hsv: per view, the median of 'frames' frames spread over the video is thresholded in HSV (OpenCV hue 0-179; red wraps around 0, hence two hue_ranges; min_saturation keeps out the pink walls, min_value the soil; if no fruit is found, it is retried with each lower fallback_min_values in turn, for dimly lit videos), opened (open_px) and closed (close_px), and round blobs (area >= min_area_px, area / enclosing circle >= min_fill) become candidates, largest max_candidates first. mesh: the combination of one candidate per view that triangulates with every reprojection error <= max_reprojection_px is the fruit (most views first). It is drawn as a lit 'shape' ('hemisphere', as in caliscope, or 'cylinder') standing 'depth' off the wall along 'normal'; null = radius measured from the blobs, depth = radius, normal = towards the mean camera centre (world units, as cameras.t_scale). The result is cached in <run>/3d/fruit/fruit.json, with each view's mask and candidates in <run>/3d/fruit/hsv/<camera>.jpg - check these if the fruit looks wrong.

leaves._readme: The green tape star around the fruit, drawn flat on the fruit's wall (needs the fruit). hsv: per view, the fruit's median frame is thresholded for green (hue_range, OpenCV 0-179; min_saturation, min_value), opened (open_px) and closed (close_px); the outer contour containing the fruit's reprojected centre (or within max_fruit_gap_px of it) is the leaves' outline. mesh: each view's outline is laid onto the wall plane (camera rays hit the plane through the fruit's base, normal = fruit normal), filled on a raster of 'resolution' within max_extent of the fruit (world units), and kept where >= min_views views agree. The terminal reports each view's IoU with the result (close to 1 = calibration and wall plane agree). Cached in <run>/3d/leaves/, masks in <run>/3d/leaves/hsv/<camera>.jpg.

arena._readme: The arena frame (a tapered box of pipes), grown out from the fruit by its measured size: no segmentation. Its back face lies on the fruit's wall, upright (the cameras' image-up direction), with the fruit fruit_height above its bottom edge and fruit_across right of its centre line; the front face is front_size, 'depth' out of the wall, on the same centre line; the bottom edges are the floor. Sizes are [width, height] between pipe centres, in world units. depth is measured from the fabric back wall the fruit is stuck to, so it is longer than the pipe-to-pipe 150 (170 fits the images of run_20261008-101724_showoff_1). It is only as good as the fruit's placement on the back wall: check the dashed frame in the reprojection images.
